app.name: SQUAD
app.title: SQUAD — find your CS2 teammates
app.footer: A good game starts with a good team.

home.headline: Find your people.
home.description: Teammates who share your goals, language and playing rhythm. Start by verifying your account.
home.comingSoon: Gaming profile editing and teammate search will arrive later.

auth.loadingDetail: Verifying Telegram data. This will take a few seconds.

identity.title: You're in SQUAD
identity.description: Your Telegram account is verified. One more step: connect Steam.
identity.contactsConsent: Contact details after a request is accepted
identity.activityShared: You allowed your Steam gaming activity to appear on your profile.
identity.activityPrivate: Your Steam gaming activity is hidden from other players.

onboarding.title: Before you begin
onboarding.description: A few simple rules to make playing together comfortable for everyone.
onboarding.usernameDescription: Teammates can use it to contact you after a request is accepted. Your phone number is not needed.
onboarding.usernameInstructions: Open Telegram settings, set your username, then return here.

rules.respect: Respect players: no harassment, threats or discrimination.
rules.fairPlay: Play fairly: no cheats or account selling.
rules.privacy: Do not publish other people's contacts or personal data.
rules.spam: No spam, scams or unwanted repeat requests.

onboarding.ageConfirmation: I am at least {{age}} years old
onboarding.rulesConfirmation: I have read and accept the community rules
onboarding.activityDescription: Optional. Let other players see total CS2 hours and hours in the last two weeks. Your game library stays hidden.
onboarding.privacyNote: Contact details are shared only after a request is accepted. Sharing gaming activity is optional and does not affect Steam linking.

steam.title: Your gaming account
steam.description: Steam verification is required for your profile to appear in teammate search.
steam.externalDescription: Sign-in opens in a separate browser. Confirm your account on Steam's website, then return to the Mini App.
steam.completeOnboarding: First confirm your age, the rules and your Telegram username.
steam.openExternal: Open Steam in an external browser
steam.browserFallback: If the browser didn't open — use this link
steam.connectionHint: If Steam does not open, try another network or turn off VPN/firewall. Then create a new link.
steam.returnInstructions: Return here after confirmation. Your status updates automatically. The link is single-use and expires shortly.
steam.passwordNote: Your password is entered only on Steam's website. SQUAD never receives it.
steam.linkedDescription: Your gaming account is verified. Get ready to find your team.

status.PENDING: Your link is ready. Continue in the browser.
status.FAILED: Linking did not finish. Create a new link and try again.
status.EXPIRED: Your link expired. Create a new one.

stats.title: Your game in numbers
stats.description: Your latest saved Steam and FACEIT stats. They update in the background; you can also request a refresh here.
stats.steamUnavailable: Steam stats are currently unavailable. Previously saved values remain visible.
stats.faceitUnavailable: FACEIT stats are currently unavailable. Previously saved values remain visible.
stats.syncFailed: The last refresh did not finish completely. Saved stats are preserved; try again later.
stats.faceitNotLinked: A matching FACEIT account has not been found yet. You can enter your nickname below.
stats.faceitLinkDescription: We check the Steam ID on the FACEIT CS2 account. Only an account matching your linked Steam can be connected.

guidance.STEAM_PROFILE_PRIVATE: Your Steam profile is private. In Steam → Edit Profile → Privacy Settings, make My Profile public, then refresh here.
guidance.STEAM_GAME_DETAILS_HIDDEN: Your Steam game details or playtime are hidden. In Steam → Edit Profile → Privacy Settings, make Game details public and disable the option to always keep total playtime private, then refresh here.

profile.title: Tell us how you play
profile.description: Choose your roles and playing schedule. Contacts are shared after a request is accepted, so leave them out here.
profile.nicknameHint: Optional: 2–32 characters, letters, digits, spaces, _ - . Leave blank to show your Steam name.
profile.bioHint: Up to 500 characters. No links, @handles or phone numbers.
profile.leaveConfirmation: Your profile has unsaved changes. Sign out and discard them?
profile.publishDescription: We check your account and saved profile before publishing. Statistics and a public Steam library are optional.
profile.futureDiscovery: Your profile is published. Player search arrives in the next milestone.
profile.privacyExplanation: Other players can see your total CS2 hours and hours in the last two weeks. Turn this off to hide those numbers. Your library, Steam ID and contacts never appear on the card.
profile.previewSaveFirst: Save your changes before publishing or refreshing the preview.
profile.previewEmpty: Save your profile to see your player card.
profile.previewUnavailable: Could not load the card. Try refreshing the preview.
profile.deleteDescription: Delete your SQUAD account and all associated data. Your Steam and Telegram accounts stay yours.
profile.deleteConfirmDescription: Your SQUAD profile, statistics, preferences and sessions will be deleted. Unsaved changes will be lost. This data cannot be restored.
profile.deleteAcknowledgement: I understand that my SQUAD data will be permanently deleted

validation.INVALID_TYPE: Check the value in this field.
validation.INVALID_OPTION: Choose one of the available options.
validation.TOO_SHORT: Your nickname needs at least 2 characters.
validation.TOO_LONG: The character limit has been exceeded.
validation.INVALID_FORMAT: Check the format: nicknames may contain letters, digits, spaces, _ - .
validation.CONTACTS_NOT_ALLOWED: Remove links, @handles and phone numbers. Contacts are shared after a request is accepted.
validation.UNKNOWN_FIELD: Update the app and try again.

errors.PUBLISH_REQUIREMENTS_MISSING: Complete the checklist below before publishing.
errors.GAME_UNAVAILABLE: Player profiles are temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
errors.PROFILE_PUBLISH_REQUIREMENTS: Complete the checklist below before publishing.
errors.PROFILE_PUBLISH_BLOCKED: Complete the checklist below before publishing.
errors.PROFILE_INVALID: Update and save your profile to meet the community rules.

ONBOARDING_INCOMPLETE.missing: Confirm your age, rules and Telegram username in step one.
ONBOARDING_INCOMPLETE.complete: Age, rules and Telegram username confirmed

PROFILE_INCOMPLETE.missing: Complete the required fields and save your profile.

errors.SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session expired. If signing in again fails, close the Mini App and reopen it through the bot.
